_comment: Manual results the live feed can't know. Set champion once decided. goldenBall is a manual FIFA award. boot settles the Golden Boot when scorers are tied on goals: the official tiebreak is goals > assists > fewest minutes played, and ESPN publishes neither assists nor minutes, so set the winner here once FIFA announces it (until then tied scorers are co-leaders). thirds optionally overrides the 8 R32 qualifiers. Blank = ignored.
